subject.title: [Feature]: Carry gateway client capabilities through the CLI/bundle-MCP backend

question: Should the CLI-backed bundle-MCP backend adopt the same client-capability propagation contract as the inline-widget/client-capability PR once that API lands?
rationale: The issue has the protected `maintainer` label and depends on an open API/security-boundary PR, so automation should not decide the permanent client-capability contract independently.

options.title: Keep As Follow-Up
options.body: Leave this issue open until the related capability-gating PR lands, then implement the CLI/bundle-MCP propagation against the accepted contract.

options.title: Fold Into Widget PR
options.body: Ask the related PR to include the CLI-backed backend path before landing, increasing scope but avoiding a known backend gap.

options.title: Reject Backend Support
options.body: Explicitly document that CLI-backed model backends do not receive web client capabilities and leave gated tools unavailable there.

recommendation.title: Keep As Follow-Up
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until the related capability-gating PR lands, then implement the CLI/bundle-MCP propagation against the accepted contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the related widget/capability PR and has the clearest current product/API context for whether this follow-up should track, fold into, or be rejected from that direction.
